basicAuth.description: Enable HTTP Basic authentication. When enabled, the SDK populates `httpclient.Options.BasicAuth` from `basicAuthUser` / `secureJsonData.basicAuthPassword`.

httpHeaders.description: Additional HTTP headers sent with every request. Forwarded to the SDK as `httpclient.Options.Header`.

keepCookies.description: Cookies, by name, that the Grafana proxy should forward to the datasource. The Grafana proxy strips all cookies by default.

oauthPassThru.description: Forward the signed-in user's upstream OAuth identity (access token) to the datasource.

queryParams.description: Query parameters added to every HTTP request. HTTP storage only.

serverName.description: Server name used for TLS SNI / certificate verification. Forwarded to the SDK as `TLSOptions.ServerName`.

storage.description: Where the CSV is read from: over HTTP, or from the local file system.

timeout.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds. Maps to `TimeoutOptions.Timeout` in the plugin SDK HTTP client.

tlsAuth.description: Validate using TLS client authentication, in which the server authenticates the client

tlsAuthWithCACert.description: Add your own Certificate Authority (CA) certificate on top of one generated by the certificate authorities for additional security measures

tlsSkipVerify.description: Skipping TLS certificate validation is not recommended unless absolutely necessary or for testing

url.description: HTTP storage: the URL of the CSV server. Local storage: the path to the CSV file or directory.

secureValues.description: PEM-encoded client certificate used for mTLS. Forwarded to the SDK as `TLSOptions.ClientCertificate`.
PEM-encoded private key paired with `tlsClientCert`. Forwarded to the SDK as `TLSOptions.ClientKey`.
